result.summary: Found several visual defects: duplicate restaurant cards with identical content, truncated restaurant names, and a missing delivery fee amount on a popular listing.

issues.description: The first two cards under 'Fastest near you' are identical duplicates (same Green Bowl Poké image, name, delivery time, and fee), which looks broken and untrustworthy.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel loads unique nearby restaurants and remove duplicate entries from the data or rendering logic.

issues.description: The third restaurant name is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' with no ellipsis, cutting off the full title mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text overflow handling (ellipsis) and/or allow the name to wrap or scale so the full restaurant name is readable.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€ delivery' with the fee amount missing (blank between € and 'delivery'), while other cards show complete fees like €0.90.
issues.suggestion: Always render the numeric delivery fee (e.g. €0) consistently next to the currency symbol.
